note: Read 2026-11-01 at the owner's word ("Build those first 3 starting with ledger first"; of the 21 countries read first: "It should cover across every country"; "Retry the blocked tax facts once all countries land"): the tax on a screen worker's pay in Saint Vincent and the Grenadines: a resident's income tax, social contributions, what is withheld at source, a non-resident artiste's withholding, an author's treatment, VAT and the tax year. Research and retry subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-tax.md, BRIEF-tax-retry.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page.

figures.finding: After a personal allowance of XCD 25,000, a resident pays 10% on the first XCD 5,000 of taxable income, 20% on the next 5,000 and 28% above.
figures.applies: As at January 2026; a higher 2026 threshold announced in December 2025 (reported by KPMG) was not confirmed.

sources.said: The rate is 10% on the first XCD 5,000 of taxable income (after deduction of the XCD 25,000 allowance; see “Deductions and allowances,” below), 20% on the next XCD 5,000, and 28% thereafter.
Deductions and allowances: Individuals are entitled to a personal allowance of XCD 25,000.

figures.finding: The tax year is the calendar year; the return is filed and tax paid by 31 March.

sources.said: Tax year: The tax year is the calendar year.
Filing and payment: The tax return must be filed by 31 March, with tax paid on the same date.

figures.finding: Social security (NIS) is 7.5% from the employer and 6.5% from the employee on earnings up to XCD 5,200 a month.

sources.said: Employers and employees are required to make social security contributions of 7.5% and 6.5% of employee earnings, respectively. The ceiling is XCD 5,200 per month for both employers and employees.

figures.finding: Tax is deducted from employees' salaries under PAYE.

sources.said: A “pay as you earn” system is used to deduct tax from the salaries of employees.

figures.finding: Royalties and fees for technical services paid to a non-resident bear 20% withholding, unless a treaty reduces it.

sources.said: A 20% withholding tax applies to royalties paid to nonresident companies and individuals, unless the rate is reduced under an applicable tax treaty.
A 20% withholding tax applies to fees for technical services paid to nonresident companies and individuals,

figures.finding: VAT is 16% (11% for hotel services); registration is mandatory above XCD 300,000 of annual supplies.

sources.said: The standard rate is 16% and a reduced rate of 11% applies to goods and services supplied by hotels,
Registration is mandatory where the annual total value of supplies exceeds XCD 300,000.

figures.finding: Whoever pays a non-resident a fee, royalty or any other income payment, including pay for independent personal services performed in Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, deducts 20% of the gross amount, and that is the final tax; a visiting entertainer's employment income stays taxable even for a stay of 30 days or less.
figures.applies: Cap. 435 s. 66 and Third Schedule; a treaty may lower it; later Finance Acts not read.
